blocks.text: Filipino historical thriller “Sisa” has been chosen as the closing-night film of the 30th Vancouver Asian Film Festival (VAFF), set for Nov. 14 at ScotiaBank Theatre Vancouver. VAFF announced that “Sisa” will close its 30th edition, describing the film as “a gripping historical revenge espionage thriller set during one of the most turbulent chapters in […]...
